title: Cartesian materialism and the Cartesian theater

statements.text: Cartesian materialism is the view that results from discarding Descartes’ dualism while keeping the image of a central, material theater in the brain where it all comes together, arrival at which is the condition for conscious experience. Dennett and Kinsbourne call it a bad idea: nothing in functional neuroanatomy suggests such a meeting place, and positing one starts a regress of homunculi.

sources.quote: Let us call the idea of such a centered locus in the brain Cartesian materialism
